## Summary

This is a sample wiki entry. Use it as a template when adding new notes.

## Key Points

- Write short, focused sections with clear headings.
- Add code fences for snippets and commands:

```bash
quarto render wiki
```

- Link related topics to help navigation, e.g. back to the [Wiki Home](index.qmd).
